name: Yanagi Asuka
source:
Romantic Stance: If falls in love, is easy to be stained in the colour of her lover.
Emotion towards protagonist: Thinks "Why is he lecturing me only !?" 

Belongs to the rhythmic gymnastics club. Is always bright, energetic and a mood maker.

Possesses extraordinary reflexes. Due to this straightforward personality, is popular regardless of gender.

However, is very ignorant regarding matters of love. There's not even a single romantic story.

On one surface is a friendly and shy person. From childhood has stuck and been pampered by her grandmother.

"Boyfriend? Having one would be a miracle! Because I am like this"

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=903610]Getchu[/url]]
